notes.title: Update

Dear's!
Most recently, we found a mistake with a unit Ghost Infantry :

During the use of a unit in Instances / Camps, players celebrated the Black Screen Error.

We managed to correct this error. Now this device does not cause any problems when used in Instances / Camps.

Additionally:
Also made a change in the battle subject of Corrosion I / II / III, we decided to remove from these points a rollback time (limit time), now it is permanent.


We always try to respond quickly to errors found and correct them to ensure comfort for our users.

Thank for chosen us.
